author: unknown
text_original: कृत्वेत्थं नारसिंहं तु ययौ विष्णुस् त्रिविक्रमः । नरसिंहः स्तम्भमध्याद् निर्गत्य प्रणनाद च ॥
text_iast: kṛtvetthaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ tu yayau viṣṇus trivikramaḥ / narasiṃhaḥ stambhamadhyād nirgatya praṇanāda ca
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment. Verse explicitly names Viṣṇu and Narasiṃha and states emergence from the pillar; Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.

author: unknown
text_original: शस्त्रास्त्रवर्षचतुरं हिरण्यकशिपुं जवात् । प्रगृह्य तु बलाद् राजन् नरसिंहो महाबलः ॥
text_iast: śastrāstravarṣacaturaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ javāt / pragṛhya tu balād rājan narasiṃho mahābalaḥ
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verse explicitly names Narasiṃha seizing Hiraṇyakaśipu. Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.

author: unknown
text_original: संध्याकाले गृहद्वारि स्थित्वोरौ स्थाप्य तं रिपुम् । वज्रतुल्यमहोरस्कं हिरण्यकशिपुं रुषा । नखैर् किसलयम् इव दारयत्य् आह सोऽसुरः ॥
text_iast: saṃdhyākāle gṛhadvāri sthitvorau sthāpya taṃ ripum / vajratulyamahoraskaṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ ruṣā / nakhair kisalayam iva dārayaty āha so ’suraḥ
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; preserves explicit twilight, threshold, lap, Hiraṇyakaśipu, and claw imagery. Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.

author: unknown
text_original: एवं वदति दैत्येन्द्रे ददार नरकेसरी । हृदयं दैत्यराजस्य पद्मपत्रमिव द्विपः ॥
text_iast: evaṃ vadati daityendre dadāra narakesarī / hṛdayaṃ daityarājasya padmapatram iva dvipaḥ
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verse states Narakeśarī tears open the Daitya king’s heart. Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.

author: unknown
text_original: ब्रह्मा च दैत्यराजानं प्रह्लादमभिषेचयत् । धर्मे रतिः समस्तानां जनानामभवत्तदा ॥
text_iast: brahmā ca daityarājānaṃ prahlādam abhiṣecayat / dharme ratiḥ samastānāṃ janānām abhavat tadā
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment; verse explicitly states Brahmā consecrated Prahlāda as Daitya king. Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.

author: unknown
text_original: श्रीशैलशिखरं प्राप्य विश्रुतः सुरपूजितः । स्थितो भक्तहितार्थाय अभक्तानां क्षमाय च ॥
text_iast: śrīśailaśikharaṃ prāpya viśrutaḥ surapūjitaḥ / sthito bhaktahitārthāya abhaktānāṃ kṣamāya ca
notes: Certified substantive Sanskrit alignment. Verse explicitly states arrival at the peak of Śrīśaila and staying there; this supports a sacred-place edge but not identification with any specific modern temple. Vedapath translation/commentary is not ingested.
